skill_interface: structured activity facts in; candidate classification out
source_policy: Use only the admitted GHG Protocol source and chain rules.
tool_policy: No network, calculator, emissions-factor lookup, or external action.
guardrail: Do not infer missing relationships or calculate emissions.
validation_rule: At most one candidate Scope; conflict yields REVIEW.
trace_policy: Record every matched and rejected relation rule.
approval_policy: Candidate classification is not inventory assurance and requires human confirmation for reporting.
invocation_contract: One immutable activity snapshot per run.
release_policy: Any Method or handler change creates a new runtime fingerprint and regression run.
